why: Puts one rule back on the raw OS query. That is the whole defect issue #631 removed, reintroduced for a single cue -- and the disagreement runs in both directions: a player who chose `reduced` against an OS saying `full` keeps the full-screen damage flash, and one who chose `full` against an OS saying `reduce` loses it against their explicit choice. The second is the case `--ui-transition-duration`'s comment had warned about for transitions since issue #364. The replacement is BRACE-BALANCED on purpose. A first draft opened the media query without closing the rule it wrapped, which broke the whole stylesheet and killed 13 tests -- a kill for a syntax error rather than for the defect, which tells you nothing about whether the contract is guarded. Killed by the no-media-query assertion in menu-transition.test.ts and by the population sweep, which stops seeing an answer for that cue.
